name: io.github.lj22503/invest-brain
description: A-share investment research: quotes, financials, behavior patterns, and trading journals.

tools.name: thought_record_thought
tools.description: Record an investment thought; AI auto-parses ticker, price, sentiment, and master match

tools.name: thought_search_memories
tools.description: Semantic search through historical thought journal entries

tools.name: thought_get_thought_cards
tools.description: Get all thought cards for a given ticker

tools.name: rag_ask_investment
tools.description: GraphRAG + vector retrieval + LLM synthesis for investment Q&A

tools.name: rag_get_master_view
tools.description: Get a specific master's view on a given topic

tools.name: rag_search_knowledge
tools.description: Search the investment knowledge base (concepts, masters, relationships)

tools.name: memory_get_user_profile
tools.description: Get user investment profile (risk tolerance, circle of competence, principles)

tools.name: memory_record_decision
tools.description: Record an investment decision; auto-triggers behavior pattern detection

tools.name: memory_get_behavior_patterns
tools.description: Get list of identified behavior patterns

tools.name: pattern_run_pattern_detection
tools.description: Run full behavior pattern detection (FOMO, early exit, emotional, principle violation)

tools.name: pattern_get_pattern_summary
tools.description: Get cumulative pattern statistics with proactive alert suggestions

tools.name: report_run_scheduled_report
tools.description: Generate this week/month behavior pattern report

tools.name: invest_roundtable
tools.description: Multi-master parallel LLM roleplay + moderator synthesis debate
